entities.summary: Dr. Haldhar Nag, popularly known as Lok Kabi Ratna, is a Sambalpuri poet and writer from Bargarh, Odisha, India. He was awarded the Padma Shri, the fourth highest civilian award of India by Government of India in 2016. He has been compared to Gangadhar Meher for his style of writing.
